subject: Logic
title: Inversion Thinking
description: A quick win: understand Inversion Thinking.

hook.text: Munger was asked how to live a great life. His answer: figure out how to guarantee a miserable one—then avoid that.

buildup.text: Inversion thinking asks: instead of how do I succeed, what would guarantee failure? Then avoid those things.

discovery.text: Jacobi, the mathematician, said it first: invert, always invert. Many hard problems become clear in reverse.

twist.text: It works because we're better at spotting obvious disasters than imagining ideal outcomes.

climax.text: Before any plan, list what would definitely make it fail. Remove those elements and what remains is stronger.

punchline.text: Avoid stupidity more than you seek brilliance.

quiz.question: What is inversion thinking?
options: Doing the opposite of what everyone else does
Identifying what guarantees failure, then avoiding it
